title: rest: every /data request's API-exposure gate reads EVERY object's metadata (with a full schema diagnostic) to check ONE object's enable flags — 62-72% of a data request's time, measured
body:
**Filing gate ①**: a product defect with a measured CI red at a public door. **`reach:`**
- the Rerun Safety nightly on `main` (#23977's reach: `activity-text-predicate.dogfood.test.ts` timed out at 5000 ms on pass 1);
- every authenticated REST `/data` read and query, which pays the same cost per request.

**Filed by** the `domain:cli` seat 2 (seat post #22648) · `os-tesla` · session `session_018t6a5rvqPRvEDMCVVW9kYT`, from #23977's dev report (`6222953587`, out-of-scope finding 1). PR #24026 fixed the timeout half of #23977; its 10 s half waits on this card. ⛔ Not a claim; the grade and lane are triage's.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:cli` seat, for the gate in `packages/rest`. The diagnostic it triggers lives in `packages/metadata-protocol`; triage routes that half if the fix belongs there.

## Where (origin/main `bb14934cd`)

- `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` `enforceApiAccess` (`:2626`–`:2646`):
  - reads `req.params.object`;
  - then `const items = await this.loadObjectItems(p, environmentId)`;
  - then `items.find((o) => o?.name === objectName)`, to read ONE object's `enable` flags.
- `loadObjectItems` (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` `:409`) → `source.listMetaItems('object')` → the protocol's `getMetaItems({ type: 'object' })` → `readFlattenedMetaItems(…, 'served')` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` about `:9723`) → `decorateMetadataItems` → `computeMetadataDiagnostics` (`metadata-diagnostics.ts` about `:55` / `:168`). That last step is a full Zod `safeParse` of every registered object's schema, on every request.

## Measured (#23977's dev, at `0c7592a22`, on that file's boot)

- An inspector CPU profile (200 µs sampling) of the `control` case's 33 list calls: 1311 of 2841 ms sampled inside `readFlattenedMetaItems`, 1244 ms of it inside `computeMetadataDiagnostics`.
- A measurement-only probe memoizing `protocol.getMetaItems` for type `object` cut the same 33 calls from 2376 / 2255 ms to 865 / 668 ms (−62 to −72 %).
- The file makes about 141 CPU-bound requests at a median of 60–74 ms each.

## Done when

- The exposure gate asks for the one object it checks, or reads a cached view that is invalidated when object metadata changes, instead of re-validating every object per request. The gate's answers do not change: the same 405s, the same fail-open on an unreadable store (#3545).
- A pin shows a `/data` request no longer triggers a full diagnostic pass. For example, count `getMetaItems({type:'object'})` calls or diagnostics runs per request.
- #23977's file is re-measured after this lands.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repository, closed included: `enforceApiAccess loadObjectItems reads every object metadata on every data request computeMetadataDiagnostics latency` gave 0 hits.

Dedupe words: enforceApiAccess per-request object list; loadObjectItems every request; computeMetadataDiagnostics safeParse data request latency; API-exposure gate cost.
